title: OpenSheaf timestamps extension: the owner's declaration, version 0.2
$comment: Part of the OpenSheaf timestamps extension 0.2 (https://opensheaf.org/opensheaf-timestamps-0.2), not of the core specification. The value of extensions["https://opensheaf.org/opensheaf-timestamps-0.2"] in the genesis record of an owner (for the first version of its key log) or in keys.json; the entry, even empty, declares that the owner timestamps every signature it makes. Closed to other properties, like the genesis records and key logs that hold it, so that nothing seems committed to that is not defined. Dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

timestampAuthorities.$comment: SHA-256 fingerprints of the signing or root certificates of RFC 3161 authorities; a signature file trusts those listed in the key-log version it names and in the versions before it, and a date earlier than that key-log version's own does not count
